newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: Indian bullion market was closed on Friday for a Hindu religious festival.
Gold is expected to attract seasonal demand after recent fall in prices, dealers said.
On Thursday, gold 24 carat closed 90 rupees lower at 4,805 rupees per 10 grammes on selling pressure from stockists following a setback in the world market.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) closed 1,100 rupees lower at 56,200 rupees after falling 700 rupees on Wednesday.
Silver (.999) was down 55 rupees at 7,500 rupees per kg.
